tables.name: trade_facts
tables.description: The closed registry of plug-in facts (pf.facts): the kinds of work a profession has, which gate branches and steps (SPEC-master 5d). One row per known fact; a profession's facts list (K-23's company_kinds.pf_facts) names only these, which code checks at each write, since an array carries no foreign key. A new fact is a registry entry written by a migration's seed (C-157), never a column. The same for every business.

tables.name: rule_kinds
tables.description: The closed registry of rule kinds: each kind of owner rule, the one type its value takes, and the plug-in fact a business's kinds of work must list before the rule is offered. An owner rule names a kind here and carries a value of that type (rules_kind_fk); a kind not here is refused. A new kind of rule is a registry entry written by a migration's seed (C-157), never a column. The kind note holds the owner's own words, which the AI reads and code never enforces.
tables.source: arch 09 lines 480, 482; C-157; S1-21; FS rows H05, H08, V11, V12, V14, V17, K10; arch 06 line 301 (limit 2)

columns.name: id
columns.description: The kind's name, lowercase words joined by underscores, such as ok_same_day or note.
columns.source: arch 09 line 480 ('A new kind of rule is a registry entry')

columns.name: value_type
columns.description: The one type its value takes: on (on or off), money (whole cents with a currency), span (a length of time), count (a whole number from 1), dates (a range of days in the business's zone) or note (the owner's words only). A dates or note kind may have several rows in effect in one scope; every other kind one at a time.
columns.source: arch 09 line 480 ('Typed values for rule values'); FS rows H05 (rules), H08 (dates), V11 (on or off), V12 (on or off + amount), V21 (amount); CQ-09 (money in whole cents)

tables.name: rules
tables.description: The owner's own rules (S1-21 gives booking_rules): each a kind from rule_kinds, a scope (the business, or one flow, one kind of work, or both) and a typed value of the kind's one type, or a note in the owner's own words that the AI reads and code never enforces. Rows carry effective dates: a change closes one row (effective_to) and opens the next, so a booking keeps the rules it was made with (K-30's terms snapshot copies them). A suggestion from the tap list becomes a row only when the owner keeps it.
tables.source: arch 09 lines 457 ('Rule type · scope · value'), 478 to 482, 488; S1-21 (gives booking_rules); S11-57; FS rows H05, H08, V11, V12, V14, V17, K10; A4-98; arch 06 line 301
